description.zh: 修改后的控制策略备注。
description.en: The new remarks of the control policy.

description.zh:
指定要修改的控制策略所在堡垒机的实例id。
>您可以调用[describeinstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the bastion host to which the control policy to modify belongs.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

description.zh: 指定要修改的控制策略的ID。
description.en: The ID of the control policy that you want to modify.

description.zh: 修改后的控制策略名称。
description.en: The new name of the control policy.

description.zh: 指定修改后的控制策略的优先级，1~100，数字越小优先级越高。默认 1。
description.en: The priority of the modified control policy. Valid values: 1 to 100. The smaller the value, the higher the priority. Default value: 1.

description.zh:
指定要修改的控制策略所在堡垒机的地域ID。
> 地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host to which the control policy to modify belongs.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

title.zh: 修改控制策略基本信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-policy --instance-id bastionhost-cn-09k1u8mv501 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id 7 --policy-name test --comment test --priority 3 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost ModifyPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --Comment test --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-09k1u8mv501' --Priority 3 --PolicyName test --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --PolicyId 7
